UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Restrict Access to Articles', 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions', '

Your site has a category Subscriber Exclusives with three in-depth articles. Visitors should see their titles and intro texts; only logged-in users may read them in full.

The category, its articles (each with a Read More) and the menu item Subscriber Exclusives are ready. Look at your site first: click Site in the toolbar of the Joomla Playground, then Subscriber Exclusives. Every visitor can read the articles now.

This tour follows the tutorial 7.4 Restrict Access to Articles of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content","com_config"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 7.4 Restrict Access to Articles', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Show the filters', '

First, show only the articles of Subscriber Exclusives. Click Filter Options.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools-btn-filter', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Filter by category', '

Click - Select Category -, type Subscriber and press Enter.

The list reloads with only the articles of Subscriber Exclusives. Then click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools-container-filters', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Select all articles', '

Tick the checkbox in the header of the list. This selects all articles in the list. Then click Next.

', 5, 'right', '.view-articles #articleList thead input[name="checkall-toggle"]', 2, 5, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Actions', '

Click Actions.

', 6, 'bottom', '.view-articles #toolbar-status-group > button', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Batch', '

Click Batch.

In the window that opens, set Set Access Level to Registered and click Process.

', 7, 'left', '.view-articles #toolbar-status-group .button-batch', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Clear the filter', '

The three articles now have the access level Registered.

Click Clear to show all articles again.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools-btn-clear', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Public and Registered', '

The Access column shows who may see each article: Public or Registered.

Look at your site and reload Subscriber Exclusives: the blog is empty for visitors who are not logged in.

Log in with the Login Form of the site as a registered test user: username reader, password reader-test-password. Now you see the articles. Log out again before you go on.

', 9, 'top', '#articleList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Options', '

Visitors should still see that the articles exist. Click Options.

', 10, 'left', '.view-articles .button-options', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Unauthorised Links', '

On the Articles tab, set Unauthorised Links to Yes. Then click Next.

', 11, 'bottom', '.com_config .control-group:has(#jform_show_noauth)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Save the options', '

Click Save & Close.

', 12, 'bottom', '.com_config .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-view-access-restrictions'), 'Test it', '

Look at your site, logged out, and reload Subscriber Exclusives: the articles show their intro texts, and their links ask you to register to read more.

Click one of those links: a login form appears. Log in as reader (password reader-test-password) and you see the full article.

', 13, 'top', '#articleList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
